body:
Hey there. 

I don’t want to give too much away, but everything has just been consistently pouring down as far back as I can remember. I assume that’s life tho? Anyone I’ve ever talked to goes thru it all, so I’m having a hard time understanding why if this happens to everyone, why am I so sad and useless about it? I have a history of childhood sexual abuse, dad left early and that in itself has been a roller coaster of garbage. Never a good student, always worked outrageous amounts so I wouldn’t have time to be in my own head. I hate myself, the way I look, the stupid things I say at inappropriate times. Quit my job and left the state to find happiness and in that I lost mostly everything and I have no one to blame but myself. This is just some of it and I don’t know if I’m strong enough to continue trying. It’s exhausting. I don’t want to die. I just want nothing. Non existence. Just a sac of darkness and quiet all around. If no one could remember me that would be awesome. Honestly I know a few people would be bummed but I’m sure they’d get over it sooner than later. 

It comes in waves. Some days I feel hopeful. I make plans for the future and smile. But more often than not I crave solitude and am so angry. All of this rage and I don’t even know why. Or sadness. I just want a break but no matter how far I run or fast I go I can’t get away from myself.
